faq_heading: Willingdon Heights condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Willingdon Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Willingdon Heights, Burnaby: 17 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 14 of 35 Burnaby communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Willingdon Heights rose from 13 in June to 17 in October (+30.8%), and 8 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.3% of Burnaby’s 1,309 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Willingdon Heights?
Willingdon Heights also had 17 houses listed and 1 sold in October, against 17 condos and townhomes listed. The Willingdon Heights houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

8 townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights with a median price of $1,090,000 (the middle half sold between $966,750 and $1,381,250), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $796 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $623 a month. 4 condos sold in Willingdon Heights, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 condos and townhomes listed in Willingdon Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Willingdon Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Willingdon Heights had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 condos and townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Willingdon Heights sell for?
faq.a: 8 townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,090,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
